# Floki v0.38.4 - Table of Contents

> Floki is a simple HTML parser that enables search for nodes using CSS selectors.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://floki.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Overview](https://floki.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Floki](https://floki.hexdocs.pm/Floki.md): Floki is a simple HTML parser that enables search for nodes using CSS selectors.
- [Floki.HTMLParser](https://floki.hexdocs.pm/Floki.HTMLParser.md): A entry point to dynamic dispatch functions to
the configured HTML parser.
- [Floki.HTMLParser.Mochiweb](https://floki.hexdocs.pm/Floki.HTMLParser.Mochiweb.md): The default HTML parser engine for Floki.

- Exceptions
  - [Floki.ParseError](https://floki.hexdocs.pm/Floki.ParseError.md)
